brief: The canvas displays a single, glowing neon line suspended against a deep black void. This luminous line constantly traces the complex, yet surprisingly uniform, contours of an electrocardiogram reading. The pattern exhibits a strong, cyclical rhythm, with spikes and dips appearing in distinct, predictable groupings. The entire reading scrolls steadily from the left side of the canvas to the right, simulating the continuous, unwavering flow of measured energy. No interaction is required; the pattern unfolds autonomously, creating a mesmerizing sense of controlled, steady energy transmission.
